newsitem.title: UK: Lower prices flush out buyers on UK meals/feeds.
newsitem.headline: Lower prices flush out buyers on UK meals/feeds.

text.p: Falls of as much as three stg a tonne in high protein soymeal prices finally flushed out some buyers on the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday.
Asking prices ex-mill were three stg down in the near positions and one to two stg lower forward.
On the east coast, where the business was done, sellers were down by a similar amount.
Jan high pro traded at 193 stg and May/Oct at 161.50 stg a tonne ex-store with traders reporting a "reasonable" tonnage changing hands.
